name: @kojo/plugin-ui-archive-browser
description: Archive browser panel (ui.panel contribution): lists archive slots from the archive read single source (archive.reader, implemented by the sav-parser plugin), expands a capped character-area summary per slot, offers the two legal extract landings (persistent workspace root / save-dialog channel), and emits the kernel event kojo.snapshotSelected. Pure presentation - parsing and disk writes live in the reader.
